title: 1991 paper on technology-assisted consciousness circulated in aerospace and CIA

tellings.quote: 1991 I wrote a paper went all through the aerospace industry and CIA which kind of also put me on the radar

plain: The UFO researcher Steven Greer says that in 1991 he wrote a paper about what he calls technology-assisted consciousness, the idea that machines can link up with the mind, and that it went "all through the aerospace industry and CIA," the US spy agency. He tells it first-hand, saying the paper is part of what put him "on the radar" of powerful people.
